children: rose 1.57% premarket after UBS upgraded it to Buy from Neutral and raised its price target to $339 from $310, roughly 19% above current prices. The firm forecasts earnings of $13.41 per share in 2026 and $14.90 in 2027, running 3% and 5% above consensus.
The firm models 2028 earnings of $16.15 per share against roughly $13.60 implied by the current price at 21x earnings, and expects 10% EBIT growth in 2027.

UBS projects 3.5% volume growth in 2027, with intermodal up 6% to 7% on current trends and the relationship between intermodal performance and the truckload pricing cycle. Low inventories should lift steel volumes, while elevated energy prices support petroleum and products. On pricing, the firm notes rail typically lags truck, which points to stronger pricing for Union Pacific and makes price and mix against inflation a neutral rather than a headwind.

title: Union Pacific Rises on a $339 Target From UBS
